body:
The v0.1.3 release run (33099663653) succeeded with this annotation on both jobs:

> Node.js 20 is deprecated. The following actions target Node.js 20 but are being forced to run on Node.js 24: `actions/checkout@v4`, `actions/setup-node@v4`.

Forced today, failing later. The point of fixing it now is that **the templates ship to adopters**: `hkb init --with-actions` writes `templates/actions/*` into their repository, so every adopter inherits our pins and will see the same annotation on their own board — a warning they cannot fix without editing generated files.

**Every site** (14 pins, `actions/checkout@v4` and `actions/setup-node@v4` throughout):

- `.github/workflows/test.yml:10,11` and `:38,39` (the `test` and `smoke` jobs)
- `.github/workflows/release.yml:41,45` (publish) and `:132` (verify)
- `.github/workflows/kanban-dispatch.yml:43,44`
- `.github/workflows/kanban-worker-claude.yml:55,58`
- `templates/actions/kanban-dispatch.yml:43,44` — **shipped to adopters**
- `templates/actions/kanban-worker-claude.yml:55,58` — **shipped to adopters**

Current latest at the time of writing: `actions/checkout@v7.0.1`, `actions/setup-node@v7.0.0`. Re-check before pinning rather than trusting these numbers, and read each action's migration notes — the major bumps between v4 and v7 carry more than a runtime change, and `setup-node`'s cache and `registry-url` behaviour is load-bearing for the publish job.

**Two tests assert the pinned string** and will fail until they are updated with the workflows — that is the coupling working, not a problem:

- `test/release.test.js:212` — `step('publish', 'actions/setup-node@v4').with['registry-url']` must stay `undefined`. That assertion exists because trusted publishing must not be handed a registry-url; keep the assertion and change only the version in the selector.
- `test/actions.test.js:148` — `step(doc, 'work', 'actions/checkout@v4')`.

**Do not rename `release.yml`, and do not move its `npm publish` step into another workflow.** The workflow *filename* is part of the trusted-publisher identity on npmjs.com (`docs/releasing.md`); bumping an action version inside the file is safe, restructuring the file is not.

**Verify.** `npm test` green; the next push shows no Node-20 annotation on `test.yml`; `hkb init --with-actions` in a scratch repo generates workflows carrying the new pins. The release path can only be fully proven by the next tag — call that out in the PR rather than claiming it was tested.
title: GitHub is forcing our v4 actions onto Node 24; bump before it becomes a hard failure
